# PlanetWare

> > Expert travel guides and destination information covering worldwide attractions, tips, and itineraries for travelers.

PlanetWare is a comprehensive travel resource owned by Static Media, featuring destination guides, travel tips, and expert advice from writers including Amy McMahon, Anna Robinson, and Dave Bowling. The site covers destinations across the United States, Europe, and worldwide, with content ranging from budget travel to iconic tourist attractions.

## Key Topics

- Travel guides
- Destination planning
- Tourist attractions
- United States travel
- Europe travel
- Budget travel
- Air travel
- Responsible tourism
- Travel tips
- Bucket list destinations
- Baedeker Guides heritage
- Static Media
- Editorial expertise
- Travel advice
- Worldwide destinations

## Core Pages

- [PlanetWare | Travel guides by the experts](https://www.planetware.com/): Homepage featuring travel guides, tips, and destinations worldwide

## Featured Travel Guides

- [The World's 17 Most Iconic Tourist Attractions To Add To Your Bucket List](https://www.planetware.com/2016021/worlds-most-iconic-tourist-attractions-add-to-bucket-list/): Guide to 17 must-see landmarks including Eiffel Tower and world attractions
